name: avisio
description: Avisio — portail de collecte et de pilotage des avis clients par plaquette NFC

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @avisio/api" "npm run dev -w @avisio/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @avisio/core && npm run build -w @avisio/api && npm run build -w @avisio/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core apps/api --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.typecheck.json --pretty false && npm run typecheck -w @avisio/web
